post.description:
Handle Razorpay webhooks.

CRITICAL ORDER OF OPERATIONS:
1. Read raw body bytes
2. Verify X-Razorpay-Signature against raw bytes
3. ONLY THEN parse JSON
4. Check idempotency (WebhookEvent.event_id)
5. Process event
6. Return 200 quickly — slow work in background

Issue a short-lived, single-use WebSocket ticket.
The ticket is an opaque token with 60s TTL.
Pass this in the WS query string instead of the JWT.
